svg.title: taeo_flat floor plan
svg.text: Floor plan in metres, north up (real compass). Mangwon-dong, Mapo-gu, fictional three-storey villa, no real address. Main room 18.0 m² (5.00 × 3.60 m) +
vestibule and wet room; 0.95 m balcony outside the one window. Ceiling 2.30 m. Redrawn to match the Codex key world/keys/taeo_flat/ (wide, reverse, detail).
bus stop + tall ad screen (NW corner of
the alley mouth; ch1 P45). Pole + lamp:
Teal = Codex mangwon_street key cameras: K1 on the bus street looking
E up the alley (its notes call this north); K2 in the alley looking W.
3F floor ≈ 6.1 m above the street. No lift, no piloti.
Street door on the ALLEY (north face), stair at the
north end; 2F/3F open-air corridors face the bus street.
1 Entrance door: grey steel, opens OUT into the open-air corridor; hinges
on the north jamb, lever on the south side (seen from inside: handle LEFT,
2 Vestibule: tiled shoe area one step down; tall shoe cabinet (north
side), coat hook, intercom panel (south side).
3 Wet room off the vestibule: shower, toilet, basin. No window. Not in the
4 Kitchenette (key): washer under the sink, 2-ring hob, white
under-counter fridge; wall cabinets and hood above.
5 Folding table: stowed against the north wall (key); set out on the floor
in ch1, 2, 5, 6 (dashed). THE CUP lives on it.
6 Desk corner (key detail): pale wood desk, wall shelf above with THE
7 Orange cone desk lamp on the desk's west end; desk chair; mug; closed
8 Bed (key): along the south wall, head at the window, grey duvet, 3
9 Folding table, in-use position (west of the circle).
10 The ONE window: two sliding panes, 1.80 × 1.20 m, sill 0.75 m;
grey-blue blackout roller blind in the box above (rolled up in the key).
Scripts that say "curtain" mean this blind.
11 Balcony 0.95 m deep, baluster railing, folded drying rack. View: the
rear lane and the backs of other villas.
12 Summon circle Ø 1.4 m, seam at its centre (ch1, ch24).
13 "1. ASK FIRST." sheet (ch21 P41 on): taped on the wet room's outside
14 Black metal clothes rack, two plain jackets, boxes below (key: by the
15 Open-air corridor, 1.30 m, waist-high rail on the bus-street (west)
side, tube lights under the slab; stairs at its north end (RIGHT coming
K1–K3: the Codex key views. P47–P54: scripts/ch001.yaml.
P47 establishing from the vestibule, looking east:
kitchenette LEFT, bed RIGHT, window far
P48 low, from the north side: Taeo on the floor, back to
P50 over Taeo's shoulder, looking north (window floats
P52 overhead, straight down on the circle
P53 low, from the bed, looking north-west at the seam
P54 low, west of the circle looking east: Nib steps out
toward camera; Taeo pressed to the bed at frame RIGHT
6·P01 high, from the ceiling above the vestibule, down the
Screen geography (lock): looking IN from the door, the
kitchenette is LEFT and the bed RIGHT, the window far.
Looking OUT toward the door, the kitchenette is RIGHT and
the bed LEFT. Never mirror the room between panels.
• ONE window, centred on the east wall:
morning sun, the rear lane below. The door
wall faces the open-air corridor and the
• Only other room: the wet room off the
vestibule. The ch6 hook ("the next room")
is NOT here: scripts/ch006.yaml stages it
• The lamp sits on the desk's west end,
about 2 m from the bed. In ch1 P52 Taeo
"knocks the lamp" by catching its cord,
which runs to the only socket beside the
• Furniture never moves unless a panel moves
it. Orrin (ch24) pins the bed and cracks
the window; both panes come out; he leaves
over the sill and the balcony onto the
ladder truck and bends the railing. Rail
stays bent, glass taped, until the move
